title: Bojjhaṅgo
text: 1.2. Sāvatthi || ārāme || tatra || voca || || 3. Ānāpānasati bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || katham bhāvitā ca bhikkhave ānāpānasati katham bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || || 4. Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu ānāpānasatisahagataṃ satisambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || ānāpānasatisahagatam dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgaṃ || viriya || pīti || passaddhi || samādhi || [page 313] Saṃyutta-Nikāya. 313 ānāpānasatisahagatam upekkhāsambojjhaṅgam bhāveti viveka- virāga- nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggaparināmiṃ || || 5. Evam bhāvitā kho bhikkhave ānāpānasati evam bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā ti || ||
